summary: Hawkeye Systems filed an 8-K reporting the sale of a 5.1% membership interest in Rift Cyber, LLC to Roy Pritchett, Jr. for $13,222. The interest sold represents 20.4% of Hawkeye's prior 25% stake in Rift, leaving Hawkeye with 19.9% membership interest. No premium, board recommendation, or advisors were disclosed. The transaction closed on the effective date of June 30, 2026, via a simple purchase agreement. As a partial divestiture of an LLC interest, the deal does not trigger regulatory clocks. What to watch: whether further stake sales follow given reduced ownership, and any impact on Rift Cyber's control structure.
